BUCKET.EXPLAIN.summary: Returns the query execution plan for a given query without executing it.
BUCKET.EXPLAIN.complexity: O(1) when the plan is cached, otherwise the cost of planning the query.

reply_schema.description: The execution plan of the query.

is_cached.description: True when the plan was served from the plan cache.

query_collation.description: The collation the query runs with. Left out when the query has no collation.

plan.description: The plan tree. The fields of a node depend on the node type.

arguments.name: bucket
arguments.summary: The name of the bucket the query runs on.

arguments.name: sortby
arguments.summary: Plan for results ordered by this field.

arguments.name: count
arguments.summary: Plan for this many documents per round trip. Defaults to the session batch size.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.summary: Plan for this many documents in total. Zero means no limit.

arguments.name: spec
arguments.summary: A collation spec for locale aware string comparison in the filter.
